Refresh source projections and summarize current project work

Usage: awr status [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --project <PROJECT>        [default: .]
      --queue <QUEUE>            Return one page of current queue items (does not include terminal history) [possible values: all, current, ready, waiting, blocked]
      --json                     
      --offset <OFFSET>          [default: 0]
      --page-size <PAGE_SIZE>    [default: 20]
      --view <VIEW>              Action is the daily queue; full/summary retain the earlier diagnostic views [default: action] [possible values: action, full, summary]
      --work <WORK>              Exact work keys in the action/summary scope; repeat to select several
      --goal <GOAL>              
      --milestone <MILESTONE>    
      --branch <BRANCH>          
      --cached                   Use the last recorded snapshot without refreshing business sources
      --source-sha <SOURCE_SHA>  Verify completion reports against this explicit full source SHA
  -h, --help                     Print help
